design.decision: one generated lightweight distribution repository per registered semantic dataset; dataset identity, TF schema version, immutable release identity, and upstream source state remain distinct
design.post_adr_contract: zero-span textual entities are represented by explicit synthetic TF slots; zero-span.json is not a mandatory distribution file
design.root_contract: a valid generated distribution contains manifest.json, README.md as a regular file, and only manifest-owned TF-root paths; source and stage paths must be disjoint

tdd.no_sidecar_red_result: 1 failed, 201 passed, 1 skipped; current ADR-0001 TF without zero-span.json was rejected
tdd.manifest_v3_red_result: 7 failed, 200 passed, 1 skipped; visible-root ownership, non-current-root corruption, and manifest/current-record tampering were not fail-closed
tdd.boundary_red_result: forbidden nested data/programs/docs, symlink injection, and nonempty unowned staging were accepted before the fixes
tdd.timestamp_determinism_red_result: 1 failed, 214 passed, 1 skipped; identical builds differed only in Text-Fabric generated @dateWritten metadata
tdd.cache_cleanup_compatibility_red_result: 1 failed, 214 passed, 1 skipped; the .tf binary-cache directory was matched by *.tf normalization after the determinism fix
tdd.foreign_backup_red_result: 1 failed, 215 passed, 1 skipped; publication could delete a pre-existing unowned stage.old sibling
tdd.source_stage_topology_red_result: 1 failed, 218 passed, 1 skipped; a stage nested below source reached a real recursive-copy attempt intercepted by the regression guard
tdd.unowned_content_red_result: 1 failed, 219 passed, 1 skipped; an injected stage/notes.txt survived validated replay outside manifest integrity ownership
tdd.readme_contract_red_result: 2 failed, 220 passed, 1 skipped; both missing README.md and README.md replaced by a directory were accepted before the fix

review.resolution_summary: manifest v3 owns and validates every visible TF root before replay/publication; sources and staged roots must be loadable and provenance-bound; publishable TF bytes are deterministic; distribution paths reject forbidden payloads, symlinks, arbitrary unowned content, foreign transaction-backup collisions, and source/stage overlap; README.md is required as a regular root artifact; legacy zero-span.json is optional under ADR-0001

verification.aa_reproducibility: two independent full-corpus benchmark builds of the same semantic head produced identical pre-load TF snapshot bytes and digest

benchmark.method: pinned Agora GitStore via loopback git daemon with /proc/net/dev RX+TX byte deltas; immutable snapshot measured before Text-Fabric load/cache mutation
benchmark.result: central and minimal repositories expose byte-identical loadable TF snapshots at pinned revisions; the minimal semantic-dataset repository reduces cold transfer from about 1.377 GB to 72.3 MB while preserving maxSlot 793340, and A/A rebuilds are byte-reproducible

resume_gate: Run exact-head repository CI and Agora benchmark for this evidence commit, obtain a fresh logically independent adversarial review of that exact head, then merge, close, and release the claim without changing the reviewed head.
